fields.name: Application Package Validator
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: nexus.spaceapplications.com/repository/docker-asb-public/eoepca/ap-validator:2025-03-05.1
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing:
      - entryname: script.sh
        entry: |-
          cd $(inputs.source_directory.path)

          ap-validator \\
              --format json \\
              --detail '$(inputs.detail)' \\
              --entry-point '$(inputs.entry_point)' \\
              '$(inputs.file_path)' > ~/ap_validator_report.json

          exit 0
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}

  inputs:
    file_path: string
    source_directory: Directory
    detail: string
    entry_point: string

  outputs:
    ap_validator_report:
      type: File
      outputBinding:
        glob: ap_validator_report.json

  baseCommand: sh
  arguments:
  - script.sh
  id: ap_validator_tool

fields.name: Bandit
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: cytopia/bandit
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing:
      - entryname: script.sh
        entry: |-
          cd $(inputs.source_directory.path)

          PARAMS="-f $(inputs.output_format) -o $HOME/$(inputs.output_file)"
          if [ "$(inputs.exit_zero)" == "true" ] ; then
            PARAMS="$PARAMS --exit-zero"
          fi
          if [ "$(inputs.verbose)" == "true" ] ; then
            PARAMS="$PARAMS -v"
          fi

          bandit $PARAMS $(inputs.file_list.join(" "))
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}

  inputs:
    exit_zero:
      label: Exit with zero
      doc: Exit with 0, even with results found.
      type: boolean
      default: true
    file_list: string[]
    output_file:
      label: Output file
      doc: Write report to filename.
      type: string
      default: bandit_report.json
    output_format:
      label: Output format
      doc: Specify output format.
      type: string
      default: json
    source_directory: Directory
    verbose: boolean

  outputs:
    bandit_report:
      type: File
      outputBinding:
        glob: $(inputs.output_file)

  baseCommand: sh
  arguments:
  - script.sh
  id: bandit_tool

fields.name: Clone repo
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: alpine/git
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing:
      - entryname: clone_branch.sh
        entry: |-
          set -e

          if [ $(inputs.repo_branch) ]; then
              echo 'Branch specified: $(inputs.repo_branch). Cloning branch...'
              git clone $(inputs.repo_url) -b $(inputs.repo_branch)
          else
              echo 'No branch specified. Cloning default branch...'
              git clone $(inputs.repo_url)
          fi
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}

  inputs:
    repo_branch: string
    repo_url: string

  outputs:
    repo_directory:
      type: Directory
      outputBinding:
        glob: $(inputs.repo_url.split('/').pop().replace('.git',''))

  baseCommand: sh
  arguments:
  - clone_branch.sh
  id: clone_tool

fields.name: Coding Best Practices for OSS
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: python:3.11-slim
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing:
      - entryname: entrypoint.sh
        entry: |-
          #!/usr/bin/bash
          cd /tmp
          echo "Downloading $(inputs.action_code_url) as file.zip"
          python3 -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlretrieve('$(inputs.action_code_url)', 'file.zip')"
          ls -l
          echo "Unzipping file.zip"
          python3 -m zipfile -e file.zip .
          echo "Done"
          pwd
          ls -l
          find .
          cd coding-best-practices-for-oss-action-main
          find .
          echo "Installing requirements"
          pip3 install --upgrade pip
          pip3 install -r requirements.txt
          echo "---"
          export INPUT_PATH_TO_CHECK="$(inputs.source_directory.path)"
          export INPUT_OUTPUT_FILE="$(inputs.output_file)"
          export INPUT_OUTPUT_FORMAT="$(inputs.output_format)"
          export INPUT_DEFAULT_ANCHOR_FILE="$(inputs.default_anchor_file)"
          set | grep INPUT
          echo "Starting the analysis ..."
          python3 main.py
          pwd
          ls -l
          echo "Moving the report file"
          mv "$(inputs.output_file)" $HOME/
          ls -l $HOME
          echo "Done"
  inputs:
    action_code_url:
      # description: "The URL of the code to execute"
      type: string
      default: "https://github.com/EOEPCA/coding-best-practices-for-oss-action/archive/refs/heads/main.zip"
    source_directory:
      # description: "The directory to check"
      type: Directory
      #default: "."
    default_anchor_file:
      # description: "Default anchor file for issues not related to specific files"
      type: string
      default: "coding-best-practices-issues.md"
    output_file:
      # description: "The report (output) file name"
      type: string
      default: "coding-best-practices-report.json"
    output_format:
      #description: "The output report format: 'generic' (SonarQube) or 'sarif' (v2.1.0)"
      type: string
      default: "generic"
  outputs:
    report:
      type: File
      outputBinding:
        glob: coding-best-practices-report.json

  baseCommand: bash
  arguments:
  - entrypoint.sh
  id: coding-best-practices-for-oss

fields.name: Report Digest Generator
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  id: digest_generator

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: python:3.11-slim
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing:
        - entryname: digest_flake8_report.py
          entry: |
            from typing import Any

            def digest(flake8_report: dict[str, Any], counts: dict[str, int] = {}) -> dict[str, Any]:
                """
                Flake8 does not report issues with severity information.
                """
                return {
                    "counts": counts,
                    "status": "Flake8 does not report issues with severity information",
                }

        - entryname: digest_pylint_report.py
          entry: |
            from typing import Any

            def digest(pylint_report: list[dict[str, Any]], counts: dict[str, int] = {}) -> dict[str, Any]:
                """
                Parses a JSON-decoded Pylint report array and aggregates it into the digest format.
                """
                for issue in pylint_report:
                    severity = issue.get("type", "").lower()
                    if severity == "fatal":
                        counts["critical"] += 1
                    elif severity == "error":
                        counts["error"] += 1
                    elif severity == "warning":
                        counts["warning"] += 1
                    elif severity == "convention":
                        counts["convention"] += 1
                    elif severity == "refactor":
                        counts["info"] += 1  # Map code smells to info
                return {
                    "counts": counts,
                }

        - entryname: digest_bandit_report.py
          entry: |
            from typing import Any

            def digest(bandit_report: dict[str, Any], counts: dict[str, int] = {}) -> dict[str, Any]:
                """
                Parses a JSON-formatted Bandit report and aggregates it into the digest format.
                """
                totals = bandit_report.get("metrics", {}).get("_totals", {})
                return {
                    "counts": {
                        "info": totals.get("SEVERITY.LOW", 0),
                        "convention": 0,
                        "warning": totals.get("SEVERITY.MEDIUM", 0),
                        "error": totals.get("SEVERITY.HIGH", 0),
                        "security": 0,
                        "critical": 0,
                        "undefined": totals.get("SEVERITY.UNDEFINED", 0),
                    }
                }

        - entryname: digest_ruff_report.py
          entry: |
            from typing import Any

            # Map Ruff rule-code prefixes to severity categories.
            # Adjust this mapping to fit classification rules as necessary.
            RUFF_CATEGORY_MAP = {
                # --- Security-related rules (bandit port)
                "S": "security",
                # --- Pyflakes — undefined names, unused imports, etc.
                "F": "error",
                # --- pycodestyle errors (E) vs warnings (W)
                "E": "error",
                "W": "warning",
                # --- Style/convention-oriented rule sets
                "C4": "convention",   # flake8-comprehensions
                "C90": "convention",  # mccabe complexity
                "N": "convention",    # pep8-naming
                "D": "convention",    # pydocstyle
                "I": "convention",    # isort
                "UP": "convention",   # pyupgrade
                # --- Informational / low-severity rule sets
                "ERA": "info",   # eradicate (commented-out code)
                "T20": "info",   # flake8-print
                "FIX": "info",   # flake8-fixme
                # --- Rules considered critical in most setups
                "B": "critical",   # flake8-bugbear (likely bugs)
            }

            DEFAULT_CATEGORY = "warning"

            def _classify_code(code):
                # Match a Ruff rule code (e.g. 'E501', 'S105') to a severity category.
                # Try longest prefixes first so e.g. 'C90' matches before 'C'
                for prefix in sorted(RUFF_CATEGORY_MAP, key=len, reverse=True):
                    if code.startswith(prefix):
                        return RUFF_CATEGORY_MAP[prefix]
                return DEFAULT_CATEGORY

            def digest(ruff_report: list[dict[str, Any]], counts: dict[str, int] = {}) -> dict[str, Any]:
                for issue in ruff_report:
                    code = issue.get("code", "")
                    if not code:
                        continue
                    category = _classify_code(code)
                    counts[category] += 1
                return {
                    "counts": counts,
                }

        - entryname: digest_ap_validator_report.py
          entry: |
            from typing import Any

            def digest(report: dict[str, Any], counts: dict[str, int] = {}) -> dict[str, Any]:
                for issue in report.get("issues", {}):
                    if issue.get("type", "") == "error":
                        counts["error"] += 1
                    elif issue.get("type", "") == "hint":
                        counts["convention"] += 1
                    elif issue.get("type", "") == "note":
                        counts["info"] += 1
                    else:
                        # It should not be possible to end here
                        pass
                return {
                    "counts": counts,
                }

        - entryname: make_digest.py
          entry: |
            import json
            import sys
            from datetime import datetime
            from digest_pylint_report import digest as digest_pylint
            from digest_bandit_report import digest as digest_bandit
            from digest_flake8_report import digest as digest_flake8
            from digest_ruff_report import digest as digest_ruff
            from digest_ap_validator_report import digest as digest_ap_validator

            tool_name = "$(inputs.name)"
            digest_data = {
                "tool": {
                    "name": tool_name,
                    "instance": "$(inputs.instance)",
                    "version": "$(inputs.version)",
                },
                "counts": {
                    "info": 0,
                    "convention": 0,
                    "warning": 0,
                    "error": 0,
                    "security": 0,
                    "critical": 0,
                },
                "created_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
                "status": "ok",
            }
            try:
                with open("$(inputs.report_file.path)", "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
                    # Load and parse the JSON file contents
                    report_data = json.load(file)
                if tool_name == "pylint":
                    digest_data = digest_data | digest_pylint(report_data, digest_data["counts"])
                elif tool_name == "bandit":
                    digest_data = digest_data | digest_bandit(report_data, digest_data["counts"])
                elif tool_name == "flake8":
                    digest_data = digest_data | digest_flake8(report_data, digest_data["counts"])
                elif tool_name == "ruff":
                    digest_data = digest_data | digest_ruff(report_data, digest_data["counts"])
                elif tool_name == "ap_validator":
                    digest_data = digest_data | digest_ap_validator(report_data, digest_data["counts"])
                else:
                     digest_data["status"]: f"Unsupported tool: {tool_name}"
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[Digest] Error generating a digest: {e}")
                digest_data["status"] = f"Failed to generate the digest: {e}"
            try:
                with open("digest.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    json.dump(digest_data, f, indent=2)
                print("[Digest] Successfully generated digest.json")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[Digest] Error writing file: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
                sys.exit(1)

  baseCommand: ["python3", "make_digest.py"]

  inputs:
    name: string
    version:
      type: string
      default: ""
    instance:
      type: string
      default: ""
    report_file: File

  outputs:
    digest_file:
      type: File
      outputBinding:
        glob: "digest.json"

fields.name: Filter
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: alpine:latest
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing:
      - entryname: script.sh
        entry: |-
          cd $(inputs.source_directory.path)
          find . -type f -regex "$(inputs.regex)" > $HOME/filter.out
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}

  inputs:
    regex: string
    source_directory: Directory

  outputs:
    file_list:
      type: string[]
      outputBinding:
        glob: filter.out
        outputEval: |-
          $(self[0].contents.split('\n').filter(function(line) {return line.trim() !== '';}))
        loadContents: true

  baseCommand: sh
  arguments:
  - script.sh
  id: filter_tool

  inputs:

fields.name: Papermill
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: continuumio/miniconda3
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing:
      - entryname: script.sh
        entry: |-
          set -e

          cat ~/err.ipynb > ~/out.ipynb
          echo "[Papermill] Source directory: $(inputs.source_directory.path)"
          echo "[Papermill] Notebook path: $(inputs.notebook_path)"
          echo "[Papermill] Extract requirements: $(inputs.extract_requirements)"
          echo "[Papermill] Extra requirements: $(inputs.extra_requirements)"
          echo "[Papermill] Execution parameters: $(inputs.execution_parameters)"

          cd $(inputs.source_directory.path)

          if [ -s environment.yml ]; then
            echo "Info: Found non-empty environment.yml file in the source folder. Will use it to setup the Conda environment."
            ENV=`grep "name: " environment.yml | cut - -d' ' -f2`
            echo "Info: Environment name: $ENV"
            cp -p environment.yml ~/environment.yml
            touch ~/requirements.txt
          else
            if [ "$(inputs.extract_requirements)" = "true" ]; then
              echo "Info: Generating requirements.txt"
              cd ~
              apt update && apt install -y jq
              pip install pipreqsnb
              pipreqsnb --force --encoding utf-8 --savepath ~/requirements.txt $(inputs.source_directory.path)/$(inputs.notebook_path)
              echo "Info: Generating environment.yml"
              ENV=`cat $(inputs.source_directory.path)/$(inputs.notebook_path) | jq .metadata.kernelspec.name -r`
              echo "Info: Environment name: $ENV"
              echo "name: $ENV" > ~/environment.yml
            else
              echo "Info: Generating environment.yml"
              pip install pyyaml
              python ~/script.py $(inputs.notebook_path) | tee ~/environment.yml
              touch ~/requirements.txt
            fi
          fi

          if [ ! -s ~/environment.yml ]; then
            echo "Error: environment.yml is empty. Aborting environment creation."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Requirements file:"
          cat ~/requirements.txt

          echo "Environment file:"
          cat ~/environment.yml

          ENV=`grep "name: " ~/environment.yml | cut - -d' ' -f2`
          echo "Info: Environment name: $ENV"

          conda env create -f ~/environment.yml
          conda run -n $ENV pip install ipykernel papermill
          conda run -n $ENV pip install -r ~/requirements.txt
          if [ "$(inputs.extra_requirements)" != "" ]; then
              conda run -n $ENV pip install $(inputs.extra_requirements)
          fi
          conda run -n $ENV ipython kernel install --user --name $ENV
          conda run -n $ENV papermill $(inputs.source_directory.path)/$(inputs.notebook_path) ~/out.ipynb

      - entryname: script.py
        entry: |-
          import json
          import yaml
          import sys

          try:
              with open('$(inputs.notebook_path)') as f:
                  nb_json = json.load(f)
          except Exception as e:
              sys.stderr.write(f"Failed to load notebook: {e}\n")
              sys.exit(1)

          conda_env = nb_json.get("metadata", {}).get("software_requirements", {}).get("conda_environment", None)

          try:
              kernel_name = nb_json["metadata"]["kernelspec"]["name"]
          except KeyError as e:
              sys.stderr.write(f"Missing key in notebook metadata: {e}\n")
              sys.exit(1)

          if conda_env:
              if conda_env.get("name", None) == kernel_name:
                  if conda_env.get("dependencies"):
                      res = yaml.dump({"name": conda_env["name"], "dependencies": conda_env["dependencies"]})
                      print(res)
                  else:
                      sys.stderr.write("No dependencies found in the environment specification.\n")
                      sys.exit(1)
              else:
                  sys.stderr.write("Kernel name does not match the conda environment name.\n")
                  sys.exit(1)
          else:
              res = yaml.dump({"name": kernel_name, "dependencies": []})
              print(res)

      - entryname: err.ipynb
        entry: |-
          {
            "cells": [
              {
                "cell_type": "markdown",
                "metadata": {},
                "source": [
                  "Error: The notebook could not be run."
                ]
              }
            ],
            "metadata": {
              "language_info": {
                "name": "python"
              }
            },
            "nbformat": 4,
            "nbformat_minor": 2
          }

  inputs:
    notebook_path: string
    extra_requirements:
      label: Python requirements
      doc: Space-separated list of Python libraries to be installed before executing the notebook
      type: string
      default: ""
    extract_requirements:
      label: Extract requirements
      doc: Inspect the notebook cells to derive library requirements
      type: boolean
      default: false
    execution_parameters:
      label: Execution parameters
      doc: These parameters are provided as inputs to the executed notebooks
      type: string
      default: ""
    source_directory: Directory

  outputs:
    output_nb:
      type: File
      outputBinding:
        glob: out.ipynb

  baseCommand: sh
  arguments:
  - script.sh
  id: papermill_tool

fields.name: Pylint
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: cytopia/pylint
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing:
      - entryname: script.sh
        entry: |-
          cd $(inputs.source_directory.path)

          PARAMS="--output-format=$(inputs.output_format) --output=$HOME/$(inputs.output_file) --disable=$(inputs.disable)"
          if [ "$(inputs.exit_zero)" == "true" ] ; then
            PARAMS="$PARAMS --exit-zero"
          fi
          if [ "$(inputs.errors_only)" == "true" ] ; then
            PARAMS="$PARAMS -E"
          fi
          if [ "$(inputs.verbose)" == "true" ] ; then
            PARAMS="$PARAMS -v"
          fi

          pylint $PARAMS $(inputs.file_list.join(" "))
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}

  inputs:
    disable: string
    errors_only: boolean
    exit_zero:
      doc: |-
        Always return a 0 (non-error) status code, even if lint errors are found. This is primarily useful in continuous integration scripts.
      type: boolean
      default: true
    file_list: string[]
    output_file:
      doc: Specify an output file.
      type: string
      default: pylint_report.json
    output_format:
      doc: |-
        Set the output format. Available formats are: text, parseable, colorized, json2 (improved json format), json (old json format) and msvs (visual studio). You can also give a reporter class, e.g. mypackage.mymodule.MyReporterClass.
      type: string
      default: json
    source_directory: Directory
    verbose: boolean

  outputs:
    pylint_report:
      type: File
      outputBinding:
        glob: $(inputs.output_file)

  baseCommand: sh
  arguments:
  - script.sh
  id: pylint_tool

fields.name: Ruff
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: ghcr.io/astral-sh/ruff:alpine
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing:
      - entryname: script.sh
        entry: |-
          cd $(inputs.source_directory.path)

          PARAMS="--output-format $(inputs.output_format) -o $HOME/$(inputs.output_file)"
          if [ "$(inputs.exit_zero)" == "true" ] ; then
            PARAMS="$PARAMS -e"
          fi
          if [ "$(inputs.no_cache)" == "true" ] ; then
            PARAMS="$PARAMS -n"
          fi
          if [ "$(inputs.verbose)" == "true" ] ; then
            PARAMS="$PARAMS -v"
          fi

          ruff check $PARAMS $(inputs.file_list.join(" "))
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}

  inputs:
    exit_zero:
      label: Exit with zero
      doc: Exit with status code "0", even upon detecting lint violations.
      type: boolean
      default: true
    no_cache:
      label: Disable cache
      doc: Disable cache reads.
      type: boolean
      default: true
    file_list: string[]
    output_file:
      label: Output file
      doc: Specify file to write the linter output to.
      type: string
      default: ruff_report.json
    output_format:
      label: Output format
      doc: |-
        Output serialization format for violations. Possible values: concise, full, json, json-lines, junit, grouped, github, gitlab, pylint, rdjson, azure, sarif.
      type: string
      default: json
    source_directory: Directory
    verbose: boolean

  outputs:
    ruff_report:
      type: File
      outputBinding:
        glob: $(inputs.output_file)

  baseCommand: sh
  arguments:
  - script.sh
  id: ruff_tool

fields.name: Save report
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: curlimages/curl
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}

  inputs:
    name: string
    instance:
      type: string
      default: ""
    pipeline_id: string
    report: File
    run_id: string
    server_url: string

  outputs: []

  baseCommand: curl
  arguments:
  - prefix: -X
    valueFrom: POST
  - prefix: -L
    valueFrom: |-
      $(inputs.server_url + '/api/pipelines/' + inputs.pipeline_id + '/runs/' + inputs.run_id + '/jobreports/?name=' + inputs.name + '&instance=' + inputs.instance)
  - prefix: -H
    valueFrom: Content-Type:application/json
  - prefix: -d
    valueFrom: $('@' + inputs.report.path)
  id: save_tool

fields.name: Save report and digest
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool
  id: save_tool
  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: curlimages/curl
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}
    InitialWorkDirRequirement:
      listing:
      - entryname: save_script.sh
        entry: |-
          #!/usr/bin/env sh
          set -e

          URL="$(inputs.server_url)/api/pipelines/$(inputs.pipeline_id)/runs/$(inputs.run_id)/jobreports/?name=$(inputs.name)&instance=$(inputs.instance)"
          echo "[Save] Backend request URL: $URL"
          REPORT_FILE="$(inputs.report_file.path)"
          DIGEST_FILE="$(inputs.digest_file === null ? 'digest.json' : inputs.digest_file.path)"
          echo "[Save] Mandatory report file: $REPORT_FILE"
          echo "[Save] Optional digest file: $DIGEST_FILE"

          # Check if the digest file does not exist OR is empty (size 0)
          if [ ! -s "$DIGEST_FILE" ]; then
            echo "[Save] Digest file is missing or empty. Creating it with an empty dictionary..."
            echo '{}' > "$DIGEST_FILE"
          fi

          # Execute the curl command
          echo "[Save] Sending POST request to $URL..."
          curl -X POST -F "report=@$REPORT_FILE" -F "digest=@$DIGEST_FILE" "$URL"

  baseCommand: ["sh", "save_script.sh"]

  inputs:
    name: string
    instance:
      type: string
      default: ""
    pipeline_id: string
    report_file: File
    digest_file: File?
    run_id: string
    server_url: string

  outputs:
    stdout: stdout

fields.name: [SonarQube] Get report
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: curlimages/curl
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}

  inputs:
    sonarqube_project_key:
      type: string
    sonarqube_server:
      type: string
      default: sonarqube-sonarqube.sonarqube:9000
    sonarqube_token:
      type: string

  outputs:
    sonarqube_project_key:
      type: string
      outputBinding:
        outputEval: $(inputs.sonarqube_project_key)
    sonarqube_report:
      type: File
      outputBinding:
        glob: sonarqube_report.json
    sonarqube_server:
      type: string
      outputBinding:
        outputEval: $(inputs.sonarqube_server)
    sonarqube_token:
      type: string
      outputBinding:
        outputEval: $(inputs.sonarqube_token)
  stdout: sonarqube_report.json

  baseCommand:
  - curl
  arguments:
  - prefix: -L
    valueFrom: |-
      $('http://' + inputs.sonarqube_server + '/api/issues/search?components=' + inputs.sonarqube_project_key)
  - prefix: -u
    valueFrom: $(inputs.sonarqube_token + ':')
  id: sonarqube_get_report_tool

fields.name: [SonarQube] Init
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: curlimages/curl
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}

  inputs:
    sonarqube_project_key:
      type: string
    sonarqube_project_name:
      type: string
    sonarqube_server:
      type: string
      default: sonarqube-sonarqube.sonarqube:9000
    sonarqube_token:
      type: string

  outputs:
    sonarqube_project_key:
      type: string
      outputBinding:
        outputEval: $(inputs.sonarqube_project_key)
    sonarqube_server:
      type: string
      outputBinding:
        outputEval: $(inputs.sonarqube_server)
    sonarqube_token:
      type: string
      outputBinding:
        outputEval: $(inputs.sonarqube_token)

  baseCommand:
  - curl
  arguments:
  - prefix: -X
    valueFrom: POST
  - prefix: -L
    valueFrom: $('http://' + inputs.sonarqube_server + '/api/projects/create')
  - prefix: -u
    valueFrom: $(inputs.sonarqube_token + ':')
  - prefix: -d
    valueFrom: $('name=' + inputs.sonarqube_project_name)
  - prefix: -d
    valueFrom: $('project=' + inputs.sonarqube_project_key)
  id: sonarqube_init_tool

fields.name: [SonarQube] Scan repo
fields.definition:
- class: CommandLineTool

  requirements:
    DockerRequirement:
      dockerPull: sonarsource/sonar-scanner-cli
    EnvVarRequirement:
      envDef:
        SONAR_HOST_URL: $('http://' + inputs.sonarqube_server)
        SONAR_TOKEN: $(inputs.sonarqube_token)
    InlineJavascriptRequirement: {}

  inputs:
    sonarqube_project_key:
      type: string
    sonarqube_server:
      type: string
      default: sonarqube-sonarqube.sonarqube:9000
    sonarqube_token:
      type: string
    source_directory:
      type: Directory

  outputs:
    sonarqube_project_key:
      type: string
      outputBinding:
        glob:
        outputEval: $(inputs.sonarqube_project_key)
    sonarqube_server:
      type: string
      outputBinding:
        glob:
        outputEval: $(inputs.sonarqube_server)
    sonarqube_token:
      type: string
      outputBinding:
        glob:
        outputEval: $(inputs.sonarqube_token)

  baseCommand:
  - sonar-scanner
  arguments:
  - prefix: -D
    valueFrom: $('sonar.projectKey=' + inputs.sonarqube_project_key)
    separate: false
  # - prefix: -D
  #   valueFrom: $('sonar.userHome=$HOME')
  #   separate: false
  - prefix: -D
    valueFrom: $('sonar.projectBaseDir=' + inputs.source_directory.path + '/../')
    separate: false
  # - prefix: -D
  #   valueFrom: $('sonar.source=$HOME' /*+ inputs.source_directory.path*/)
  #   separate: false
  - prefix: -X
  id: sonarqube_scan_tool

fields.name: Trivy
